ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution dominated by approximately 85-90% high-intensity white pixels with a 10-15% low-intensity black border and central peduncle marking.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white field spanning both lobes; solid low-intensity black boundary along the entire trailing edge; vertical black band at the peduncle-fluke junction; black vertical striations and mottling on the distal lateral tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 75-80 degrees relative to the lobe convergence point.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular jagged contour; right lobe trailing edge exhibits deep vertical indentations (notches); left lobe trailing edge displays continuous, lower-amplitude serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Leading edge displays an upward and outward convex sweep; trailing edge follows a broad concave arc converging at the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct cluster of high-contrast, textured, roughly circular pixel groups (barnacle colonization) localized on the distal end of the right lobe tip; small circular indentations visible across the central white surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct vertical black linear pixel disruptions on the distal right lobe; faint vertical linear indentations traversing the white field on both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent colonization of sessile barnacles on the right distal fluke tip; irregular black pigmentation and minor surface trauma at the lower midline peduncle attachment.
other_distinctive_markers: Single isolated low-intensity circular spot located in the upper-left quadrant of the interior fluke surface.
